findings.finding: The cart storefront GraphQL adapter converted GraphqlHttpError to ApiError::Graphql using the full display string, and all three public facade closures delegated to that adapter without an owner sanitizer.
findings.resolution: Create an operation-specific per-call context at the public consumer boundary and map only ApiError::Graphql to static public envelopes.

findings.finding: Cart UUID, line-item UUID, and quantity-command validation execute before the GraphQL request and return ApiError::Validation.
findings.resolution: Pass Validation and ServerFn variants through unchanged and leave the private adapter and core policy unmodified.

findings.finding: The selected GraphQL paths had no cart-owner correlation event retaining operation and safe request-shape context.
findings.resolution: Generate a unique per-call correlation id and retain only configuration facts, identifier lengths, optional-field presence, and command kind in internal diagnostics.

preserved_behavior: private GraphQL query and mutation documents
cart storefront request and response DTOs
Commerce aggregate cart and payment composition
